preamble: Edit this image. Keep the canvas size, the head's position, size and angle, the four black corner crosses and the flat pure green background exactly as they are. Change only what is described below. Paint it by hand, matte and muted, like a plate in an old illustrated field guide: soft light from the upper left, no outlines, no gloss or shine, no text, no extra objects, no new background.

fix_lines.size: The image must stay exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels: do not crop or resize.
fix_lines.crosses: Keep the four black crosses in the corners exactly where they were; do not move, redraw or remove them.
fix_lines.key_border: Keep the background one flat pure green (#00FF00) everywhere: no shading, texture, vignette or scenery.
fix_lines.skull_match: Keep the back of the head, the crown, the ear and the nape exactly where they were in the original; change only the face in front of the ear.
fix_lines.head_overall: Keep the head the same size and in the same place; only the jaw, chin, cheeks and nose may change.
fix_lines.on_the_head: The piece must sit exactly where it would on the original head: same size and place, nothing floating away from it.
fix_lines.off_the_face: Nothing may cover the face: keep the hair (or cap) behind the hairline and above the ear.
fix_lines.style_gloss: Make it matte and painted by hand: no shine, no 3D-render look, no outlines.
fix_lines.style_angle: Keep the exact side-on profile, facing right, as in the original; do not turn the head.
fix_lines.style_extra: Remove everything that was not asked for: no text, no objects, no shoulders, no background detail.
fix_lines.style_colour: Paint it in one neutral mid grey only, with no colour.
fix_lines.trait: Make the asked-for change clearly visible: {change}
